explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/838: f(n) is the least number of convex subsets determined by n points in ℝ² with no three collinear; 'Estimate f(n)', with Erdős's bounds n^{c₁ log n} < f(n) < n^{c₂ log n}. The Lean value question asks for answer with log f(n) ~ answer(n), where f n is the minimum over n-point non-trilinear P of the number of subsets in convex position (counting ∅, singletons and pairs, a polynomial shift that is negligible against n^{c log n}). Reading 'estimate' as an asymptotic formula for log f(n) is natural given the known bounds and the follow-up question about lim log f(n)/(log n)², and is documented. Faithful.
